title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
statement: Return the minimum element of a rotated sorted array of distinct values.
hints: The minimum is the only element that is smaller than its left neighbor, unless the array is not rotated.
Compare nums[mid] with nums[hi]. If mid is larger, the minimum is to the right of mid.
Otherwise the minimum is at mid or to its left, so hi becomes mid.
editorial: If nums[mid] > nums[hi], the rotation point, and therefore the minimum, is strictly to the right of mid. Otherwise mid could be the minimum, so hi moves to mid and mid stays inside the interval. The loop uses lo < hi and finishes with both ends on the minimum.

examples.explanation: The minimum is the first element.
